title: The merge tool's silent-undo scan follows renamed files
why: Incident, Nov 1 17:17 and 17:38 CST (coordinator): joyous PR #53 renamed gates.yml to checks.yml, and the merge tool refused it twice although the line moved unchanged.
note: Cause: the silent-undo scan in ~/.claude/bin/merge reads each path on its own and does not follow renames. Fix: diff with rename detection, so a line that moves with its file counts as kept. Red first: a fixture PR that renames a file with an unchanged line is refused today. Guard basis: named incident (Nov 1). Ready: no open question; the coordinator starts it on triage's word. In batch 60 as PR #984, not merged at Nov 1 18:57 CST.
